RFC8277-2-2.note: Forbidden: a single-label binding transmitted in any layout other than the Section 2.2 one. TestLabeledSingleLabelSection22Encoding goes red on it for LabeledUnicast.WriteTo (require.Equal on the whole encoding, and the Length-octet assertion). The second transmit producer, UpdateBuilder.BuildLabeledUnicastNLRIBytes (internal/component/bgp/message/update_build_labeled.go), which the static-route and grouped-announce paths reach through BuildLabeledUnicast and which writes labels with nlri.WriteLabelValues, is not exercised by any tagged unit, so breaking its layout turns nothing red.

RFC8277-2.2-1.note: RA33 strict re-audit: stays weak (blind reader's final 'enforced' not adopted, with evidence). Forbidden: a single label entry transmitted with S=0. The tagged unit asserts got[3]&0x01==1 for LabeledUnicast.WriteTo via nlri.WriteLabelStack only. A second production transmitter, UpdateBuilder.BuildLabeledUnicastNLRIBytes (message/update_build_labeled.go:261,266) and the VPN builder (update_build_vpn.go:272,278), sets S through nlri.WriteLabelValues (helpers.go:97), which no tagged unit exercises; dropping that line stays green. The {single-polarity} argument names WriteLabelStack as the only encoder and is therefore incomplete.

RFC8277-2.2-3.note: The quoted sentence has two clauses. Reception clause: forbidden is rejecting or mis-decoding an NLRI whose Rsrv bits are non-zero; TestLabeledRsrvIgnoredOnReceive asserts NoError plus equal label, prefix and framing for Rsrv=0b111 through both ExtractLabels and SplitLabeled, so that clause is enforced. Transmission clause (SHOULD set Rsrv to zero): no tagged unit asserts the Rsrv bits ze transmits, so a sender writing non-zero Rsrv turns nothing red. The multi-label case of the same reception rule (Section 2.3) is also not exercised: every input carries one label.

RFC8277-2.3-1.note: Forbidden: a non-last label entry transmitted with S=1. TestLabeledLabelStackSBitPlacement asserts entry[2]&0x01 == 0 for every non-last entry of 2- and 3-label stacks, which goes red for LabeledUnicast.WriteTo via nlri.WriteLabelStack. The UpdateBuilder path (BuildLabeledUnicastNLRIBytes -> nlri.WriteLabelValues) places the S bit in separate code that no tagged unit exercises.

RFC8277-2.3-2.note: Forbidden: the last label entry transmitted with S=0. TestLabeledLabelStackSBitPlacement asserts entry[2]&0x01 == 1 on the last entry of 1-, 2- and 3-label stacks, which goes red for LabeledUnicast.WriteTo via nlri.WriteLabelStack. The UpdateBuilder path (BuildLabeledUnicastNLRIBytes -> nlri.WriteLabelValues) sets the S bit in separate code that no tagged unit exercises.

RFC8277-2.5-1.note: Forbidden: keeping L1 bound, or holding two bindings, after U2 for the same prefix and next hop without ADD-PATH. TestLabeledImplicitWithdrawalNoAddPath feeds U1 then U2 through feedReceived and asserts Len()==1 (U1 no longer bound, goes red if a second entry is kept) and labelsFor==[200] (L2 bound, goes red if L1 survives). The negative is a boundary case rather than a violating input: an UPDATE for a different prefix must not withdraw the first binding (Len()==2, label 200 kept).

RFC8277-2.5-2.note: RA33 strict re-audit: weak. Clause 'U1 implicitly withdrawn': Len()==2 after re-advertising path 9 goes red if a third entry is kept. Clause 'L2 is now bound to P at N1': labelsFor(cidr9)==[300] does not isolate path 9, because label side-data is keyed on the prefix alone (the RFC8277-2.5-3 finding), so it passes whichever path's binding holds 300 and would pass with L2 bound to the wrong path. No assertion goes red on L2 not being bound to path 9 specifically.

RFC8277-3.1-1.note: Forbidden: treating two same-prefix routes with different labels as incomparable, or using the label in selection. TestLabeledRoutesWithDifferentLabelsAreComparable covers the first case of the sentence's premise, routes on different BGP sessions (gatherCandidates Len==2, SelectBest winner unchanged when labels swap). The second case the sentence covers, two routes on the same add-paths session with different path identifiers, has no assertion in any tagged unit.

RFC8277-3.2.1-1.note: Quote covers SAFI-4 and SAFI-128. TestLabeledPropagationUnchangedNextHopKeepsLabels pins SAFI 4 and TestLabeledVPNPropagationUnchangedNextHopKeepsLabels pins SAFI 128: next-hop-unchanged emits no op and mpReachNextHopHandler plans the MP_REACH verbatim, with the Next Hop, label entry, RD and prefix asserted byte for byte. The {single-polarity: positive} annotation holds: the RFC imposes nothing on a changed next hop. Observed-red record on mpReachNextHopHandler.
